boundary: 'proved' means a complete written proof in the manuscript, not formal verification; 'certified-finite' means an exact deterministic computation, claimed only for the stated finite range. Internal AI-assisted review is not peer review or independent reproduction.

claims.statement: Exact list of orientation changes a capped service can cause (necessity for every rate function; exactness under positive rates); under positive rates, recurrence reduces to a finite digraph on acyclic orientations.
claims.computationalCheck: census_small_graphs.py compares the lemma with simulation on all 104,590 (graph, cap, orientation) triples with at most 6 vertices

claims.statement: Uncapped service of a full upper queue is extended promotion on linear extensions; the cap truncates it after the w-th comparable pair.

For every w >= 2 the balanced states of C_{2w+1} form a set closed under every admissible rate function, of height w+1, a single recurrent class under positive rates, with (2w+2)!/(w!)^2 states; Conjecture 1 of Dorsman and Gardner is false for every w >= 2.
On C_n with cap w and positive rates, a recurrent class of excessive height exists iff n = 1 (mod 2w); it is then unique. For w >= 2 the conjecture therefore fails on C_n exactly when n = 1 (mod 2w).
Two odd cycles C_{2a+1}, C_{2b+1} joined by a path of length L violate the conjecture at cap w = a+b+L+1 under positive rates.
Among all connected graphs with at most 7 vertices and every cap with chi(G) <= w+1 <= n-1, there are 1355 violating (graph, cap) pairs under positive rates; none bipartite; none at w = 1.
Under the symmetric lift of the rate functions, several jobs per class reduce to one job per class on the blow-up graph.
Listed multiplicity vectors on C_5, C_7, C_9 lose their high classes; K_3 with two jobs per class (and the bowtie) still violate.
For bipartite swapping graphs, odd w and positive rates, every state of height greater than w is transient; in particular the conjecture holds at w = 1.

No connected bipartite graph with at most 9 vertices violates the conjecture at any cap under positive rates, nor with at most 7 vertices under head-only service. The general even-cap case is Conjecture 7.2 (open).
With homogeneous rates the stationary law on the balanced class is uniform in the global word and binomial in the split; it satisfies the source's partial-balance equations.

On the balanced class of C_{2w+1}, for additive per-job rates and every w >= 2, original product weights times one constant per orientation are stationary iff the rates are constant within each queue. Other closed forms are not excluded.

On C_5 with rates (1,1,1,1,a): total variation of the orientation-matched approximation below 2e-3 for the listed a; absorption probabilities 1/7 and 2/7; long-run probability 67/252 of the high class from a uniform start.

open: Conjecture 7.2: bipartite swapping graphs, even caps.
General order-independent (head-only) rates beyond the certified range.
Characterisation of all (G, w) with a recurrent class of excessive height.
Closed form for the heterogeneous stationary law on the balanced class.
